expected.headline: 育碧裁撤蒙特利尔与魁北克166个岗位，同时成立AI工作室Motherbrain
expected.summary: 育碧宣布旗下蒙特利尔与魁北克团队合计裁减166人，并在随后财报中公开专注游戏AI技术的新工作室Motherbrain，方向包含可保留记忆的NPC。

replacement.headline: 日媒转述育碧此前两项消息：裁减166个岗位，成立AI子公司Motherbrain
replacement.summary: AUTOMATON在本期窗口内转述了育碧此前披露的两项消息：蒙特利尔和魁北克团队合计裁减166个岗位；育碧另在财报中宣布设立专注游戏AI的子公司Motherbrain，研究方向包括能保留记忆的NPC。报道未证实两者存在直接因果关系。

englishExpected.headline: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs while launching AI-focused studio Motherbrain
englishExpected.summary: Ubisoft announced 166 job cuts across its Montreal and Quebec teams, then disclosed Motherbrain, a new studio focused on game AI technology including persistent-memory NPCs.

englishReplacement.headline: AUTOMATON reports on Ubisoft’s earlier job cuts and Motherbrain announcement
englishReplacement.summary: AUTOMATON’s report falls within this edition’s window; the underlying disclosures predate it. Ubisoft cut 166 roles across its Montreal and Quebec teams and separately announced Motherbrain, a game AI subsidiary working on areas such as NPCs with persistent memory. The report does not establish a direct causal link.

evidence.excerpt: AUTOMATON, Nov. 20 11:30 JST: 166 positions, Motherbrain as a new specialist subsidiary, and no demonstrated direct link.
evidence.reason: This edition captures the Japanese relay, not the first disclosures; clarify timing and separate the two developments without changing the source clock.

expected.headline: OpenTracks调整许可规则：标注署名后可在音乐游戏中使用音源
expected.summary: OpenTracks（原DOVA-SYNDROME）在11月20日说明，音乐与节奏游戏可在通常许可范围内使用站内音源，但需按要求标注作曲者等署名信息。

replacement.headline: OpenTracks允许音游按通常许可使用音源，新作须标注曲名及作曲者
replacement.summary: OpenTracks（原DOVA-SYNDROME）在11月20日说明，音乐与节奏游戏可按通常许可使用站内音源。2027年1月1日起新公开的作品须标注曲名与作曲者，此前公开的作品可自愿标注；相关许可及帮助说明将于2026年12月1日更新。

englishExpected.headline: OpenTracks restores rhythm-game use under its standard license
englishExpected.summary: OpenTracks, formerly DOVA-SYNDROME, says music and rhythm games may use its tracks under the standard license as long as required composer credits are displayed.

englishReplacement.headline: OpenTracks allows rhythm-game use under its standard license, with credits required for new titles
englishReplacement.summary: OpenTracks, formerly DOVA-SYNDROME, says music and rhythm games may use its tracks under the standard license. Games first released from January 1, 2027 must credit the track title and composer; credits are optional for earlier releases. The license and help pages will be updated on December 1, 2026.

evidence.excerpt: AUTOMATON’s original report distinguishes the January 1, 2027 cutoff for newly published games from the December 1 documentation update.
evidence.reason: The original copy wrongly suggests credits are mandatory for all games. Both dates and the earlier-release exception are in the selected source.
